name: enso-photo-culling-tool
description: AI-powered photo culling tool executors for Enso — scan shoot folders, detect sharpness via Laplacian variance, group bursts by timestamp, flag blurry/eyes-closed shots, and export selections

notes.sharp: Required for Laplacian variance sharpness detection and pHash computation. Resize, grayscale, convolution.
notes.exifr: Required for lightweight EXIF metadata extraction (DateTimeOriginal, Make, Model, ISO, ExposureTime, etc).
notes.@vladmandic/face-api: Optional. Enables face detection and eyes-closed detection via Eye Aspect Ratio (EAR). Requires model files in node_modules/@vladmandic/face-api/model/.
notes.@tensorflow/tfjs-node: Optional. TensorFlow.js backend for face-api. Required if face-api doesn't bundle its own tf.
